information:
# Note: This is a midnight competition. 

Welcome to Don't Sleep in Pelita Sungai Dua 2026! This will be a **midnight** competition, please look through the schedule before registering. 
[![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/Don'tSleepInPelitaSungaiDua2026)

All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontSleepInPelitaSungaiDua2026#75785-updates-announcements). New competitors, in particular, should carefully read the ["**New Competitors**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontSleepInPelitaSungaiDua2026#75786-new-competitors) for essential details before registering.
​
Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
